chapter_seo_title: Dao Guai Yi Xian Ch 39: Li Huowang Has a Nightmare & Buys Supplies
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang tries to repay Bai Lingmiao, suffers a horrifying Danyangzi nightmare, buys supplies, and meets a suspicious old monk. But the Fool has found “wild white rice” in the forest.
og_description: One nightmare, two donkey carts, and a very suspicious old beggar. Li Huowang’s road to Xijing just got a little stranger.
twitter_title: Wild White Rice on the Road to Xijing
twitter_description: Li Huowang: buying quilts. The Fool: eating forest rice. One of these is a very bad idea.
